_comment: CANOPUS local-LLM asset catalogue for the 'On this host (SBC)' backend. The GGUF model + arch-matched llama.cpp llama-server binary are downloaded on demand (excluded from the .deb, like the DSO thumb / ncnn packs) into the writable data dir. The model pulls from a public Hugging Face mirror; the llama.cpp runtimes point at a 'data-pack' GitHub release that must be published per arch (linux-arm64 has no upstream llama.cpp binary and needs a self-build). sha256 is optional: when empty the download is used as-is (verification skipped). Operators who already have the files on the box can bypass all of this with Canopus:ModelPath / Canopus:LlamaServerPath.
